title: The Summons
subtitle: Bring your name, in writing
description: The task below is an ordinary item task. What makes this quest the
interesting one is its reward: a stage reward grants the stage
`the_induction:marked`, a flag that is now yours and nobody else's.
Nothing about the flag lives in this file's chapter. It is granted
here, asked about next door, and cleared at the end of the row --
the same flag in three places, which is how a pack uses one.
